namespace Geometry.Services;

public partial class ShapeService : IShapeService
{
    private readonly IRepository<Circle> _repo;
    private readonly ILogger<ShapeService> _logger;
    public ShapeService(IRepository<Circle> repo, ILogger<ShapeService> logger) { _repo = repo; _logger = logger; }
    partial void OnCreated();
}

public partial class ShapeService
{
    public async Task<Circle?> GetAsync(int id)
    {
        var c = await _repo.FindAsync(id);
        _logger.LogInformation("got {Id}", id);
        return c;
    }
}
